news.headline: AP source says an unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack
news.summary: According to an AP source, an unclassified CIA system was breached in a cyberattack. It is not yet clear what specific information was compromised or who is responsible.
news.chaosTwist: Santa's naughty list now has a spy agency on it, and even the elves are asking why the reindeer got classified access.

sources.title: An Unclassified CIA System Was Breached in a Cyberattack, AP Source Says
